# Air Wisconsin

> Regional airline operating Bombardier CRJ-200 aircraft with a focus on pilot, flight attendant, and maintenance careers across the Midwest and East Coast.

Air Wisconsin is a regional airline based in Appleton, WI, operating scheduled routes and charter services. The site emphasizes career opportunities, safety commitment, and aircraft operations for potential employees and aviation professionals.

## Key Topics

- Regional airline operations
- Pilot careers
- Flight attendant careers
- Maintenance technician careers
- Bombardier CRJ-200 aircraft
- Safety management systems
- Company culture
- Veteran recruitment
- Charter services
- FAA compliance
- IAMAW union benefits
- Midwest and East Coast routes
- General Electric CF34-3B1 engines
- Collins Pro Line 4 avionics

## Career Opportunities

- [Pilots](https://airwis.com/Careers/Pilots): Pilot career opportunities and hiring requirements at Air Wisconsin
- [Flight Attendants](https://airwis.com/Careers/FlightAttendants): Flight attendant careers, job requirements, and benefits at Air Wisconsin
- [Maintenance](https://airwis.com/Careers/Maintenance): Maintenance technician and mechanic careers with IAMAW union benefits
- [Corporate/Management](https://airwis.com/Careers/Salaried): Corporate and management positions in Appleton, WI headquarters
- [Veterans](https://airwis.com/Careers/Veterans): Veteran recruitment and career transition programs at Air Wisconsin
- [Our Team](https://airwis.com/Careers/Team): Air Wisconsin company culture, team events, and community involvement

## About Air Wisconsin

- [About](https://airwis.com/About/Profile): Air Wisconsin Airlines company mission, values, history, and safety focus
- [Safety](https://airwis.com/About/Safety): Air Wisconsin safety commitment, management systems, and incident reporting
- [Routes](https://airwis.com/Travel/Routes): Air Wisconsin airline routes, domiciles, and operations information

## Aircraft & Operations

- [Aircraft](https://airwis.com/About/Aircraft): Bombardier CRJ-200 aircraft specifications, performance data, and avionics
- [Charter](https://airwis.com/Contact/Charter): Charter flight service using Bombardier CRJ-200 aircraft

## Contact & Support

- [Contact](https://airwis.com/Contact): Air Wisconsin contact information and headquarters in Appleton, WI
- [Applicant Policy](https://airwis.com/Careers/ApplicantPolicy): Equal opportunity hiring policy, e-Verify compliance, and application guidelines
